scope: Native Windows RTX 4070 SUPER/Vulkan, high tier, 1280x720 HDR/bloom, PlaybackOnly. Three ordinary-transparency independent-host image runs and three authored-pair experimental-OIT image runs, with a separate near-view profile. Camera poses follow the root clock; no effect, budget, material or renderer change.

runs.name: host-side
runs.camera_scope: Image orbit reads the root clock after Playback, before render preparation/transform propagation. Capture poses are request-time local transforms of the unparented camera; image and GPU observations arrive asynchronously. Constant 180-unit horizontal radius, y=48, target=(0,28,0), yaw=30-75*cos(2*pi*t/16) degrees. No lens, effect, seek or history changes; fixed views ignore the orbit formula.

selected_lighting.scope: Asynchronous native adapter capacity/dispatch metadata, not live or illuminated particle counts. No selected-position readback.

encoding_ledger.scope: CPU command encoding only; asynchronous latest frame, no GPU completion fence or visible-pixel assertion. Stateful quantization up to one simulation tick is expected.

near_overflow_profile.note: Separate timestamp lane, not image-frame-paired or an incremental/full-game cost estimate. Shows the existing full-target overflow pass executes; over-sort pixel counts identify its work, not a dropped-layer/approximate-blending failure.

limits: Asynchronous screenshots and counts, sampled motion only. Host per-draw sorting is not global inter-owner order. Pair over-sort counters measure work above the local fast path before the existing overflow merge sort; they do not themselves indicate approximate blending or dropped layers. Full-target accepted lists are preordered before resolve. Unsupported subviews/cold paths and foreign transparent participation remain separate limitations. Near framing intentionally crops parts of the expanded shells. No default-art, exact compositing or production-finale acceptance.
